description: This file defines the 'Attribute' class in the 'Opencart.Admin.Model.Catalog' namespace, containing methods for managing product attributes including adding, editing, deleting, and retrieving attribute data and descriptions in the OpenCart system.

classes.name: Attribute
classes.description: Model class for handling product attribute data, including CRUD operations and description management.

methods.name: addAttribute
methods.description: Creates a new attribute record in the database and adds its descriptions.

methods.name: editAttribute
methods.description: Updates an existing attribute record and its descriptions based on attribute ID.

methods.name: deleteAttribute
methods.description: Deletes an attribute and its descriptions from the database by attribute ID.

methods.name: getAttribute
methods.description: Retrieves a specific attribute record including its description based on attribute ID.

methods.name: getAttributes
methods.description: Fetches multiple attributes with optional filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalAttributes
methods.description: Returns the total number of attribute records in the database.

methods.name: getTotalAttributesByAttributeGroupId
methods.description: Returns the total count of attributes belonging to a specific attribute group.

methods.name: addDescription
methods.description: Adds a description for a specific attribute and language.

methods.name: deleteDescriptions
methods.description: Deletes all descriptions associated with a specific attribute.

methods.name: deleteDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes all attribute descriptions for a specific language.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Retrieves a specific description for an attribute and language.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Fetches all descriptions for a given attribute.

methods.name: getDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Gets all attribute descriptions for a specific language ID.
